steps.en: Install the package into Python 2.7 or 3.5
steps.zh: 在 Python 2.7 或 3.5 里装上这个包

steps.en: Register a handler function for a message type
steps.zh: 给某类消息注册一个处理函数

steps.en: Log in by scanning the QR code with your phone, then start the loop
steps.zh: 用手机微信扫码登录，再启动主循环

steps.en: Holds the web-WeChat session and long-polls its synccheck endpoint for new messages
steps.zh: 保持网页版微信会话，长轮询 synccheck 接口拉新消息

steps.en: Wraps each message as a dict-like object and calls your handler
steps.zh: 把每条消息包成类字典对象，调用你的处理函数

steps.en: Sends your handler's return value back to the sender as a reply
steps.zh: 把处理函数的返回值作为回复发回给对方

value.en: A personal-account auto-reply bot in under thirty lines — when the web login still worked
value.zh: 不到三十行写出个人号自动回复机器人——前提是网页登录还能用
